skills.name: account-research
skills.description: Activate when researching a specific company or authorized buyer for a GTM decision, outreach draft, qualification review, or investigation; use existing Neyvro company-twin evidence before requesting new research.

skills.name: buyer-matching
skills.description: Activate when matching a target account or problem to buyer roles using authorized company and contact evidence.

skills.name: buying-windows
skills.description: Activate when assessing whether dated company changes create a timely, evidence-backed opportunity to investigate or propose outreach.

skills.name: cold-email-writing
skills.description: Activate when drafting or reviewing an evidence-grounded outbound email from an authorized opportunity, buyer, product, positioning, channel, and tone; this skill never sends messages.

skills.name: company-changes
skills.description: Activate when detecting, explaining, or reviewing material changes in a target company's business context.

skills.name: content-marketing-engine
skills.description: Activate when planning, drafting, repurposing, distributing, or measuring customer content from verified buyer questions, positioning, research, and approved brand voice; publishing always requires an authorized channel and explicit approval.

skills.name: continuous-investigation
skills.description: Activate when creating, monitoring, reviewing, assigning, or correcting a bounded Neyvro investigation.

skills.name: digital-twins
skills.description: Activate when building or reviewing an evidence-backed, time-aware projection of a company, buyer, or opportunity.

skills.name: discovery-and-qualification
skills.description: Activate when qualifying an authorized sales opportunity or preparing a discovery-call brief using evidence, buyer research, conversation context, CRM records, and meeting history; never qualify from AI inference alone.

skills.name: email-deliverability
skills.description: Activate when assessing authorized Gmail or Microsoft mailbox readiness, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, sender limits, bounce or complaint risk, recipient hygiene, or safe email ramp-up; never change DNS or send mail.

skills.name: evidence
skills.description: Activate when collecting, viewing, evaluating, correcting, or citing source-attributed evidence for Neyvro intelligence.

skills.name: generative-engine-optimization
skills.description: Activate when assessing or improving an authorized website’s discoverability, answer-first content, entity clarity, structured data, AI-crawler access, freshness, or measurement plan for AI answer engines; never promise citations or fabricate visibility.

skills.name: gtm-automation-with-chronos
skills.description: Activate when a user asks to turn GTM planning into external execution through an authorized MCP or provider.

skills.name: gtm-automation-with-neyvro
skills.description: Activate when coordinating Neyvro knowledge skills with connected customer intelligence, research, drafting, campaign, mailbox, conversation, meeting, SEO/GEO, content, or analytics services; use capability discovery and approval gates before any external action.

skills.name: gtm-strategy
skills.description: Activate when selecting, reviewing, or refining a product's go-to-market motion, acquisition channels, or 30/60/90-day execution plan.

skills.name: ideal-customer-profile
skills.description: Activate when defining, refining, scoring, or reviewing an ICP, buyer personas, target-account filters, trigger events, or anti-ICP rules.

skills.name: lead-sourcing-and-enrichment
skills.description: Activate when selecting ICP-fit accounts, finding buyer roles, or enriching authorized business contacts with deduplicated, provenance-labeled, verified data.

skills.name: linkedin-outreach
skills.description: Activate when researching an authorized professional profile, selecting a relevant LinkedIn outreach angle, drafting a connection note or direct message, or recording customer-confirmed manual outreach; never automate LinkedIn actions.

skills.name: multichannel-sequences
skills.description: Activate when designing, reviewing, compiling, or operating a customer-approved multichannel outreach sequence with deterministic timing, branches, eligibility checks, and stop rules.

skills.name: negative-evidence
skills.description: Activate when recording, evaluating, or explaining disconfirming evidence, missing signals, or reasons not to act.

skills.name: outbound-metrics-and-benchmarks
skills.description: Activate when analyzing outbound funnel performance, campaign health, attribution, or contextual benchmarks using Neyvro campaign, conversation, and CRM records; every metric must expose its numerator, denominator, time window, segment, and data limitations.

skills.name: outreach-personalization
skills.description: Activate when turning authorized company, buyer, opportunity, positioning, and brand-voice context into evidence-linked personalization snippets at strategic, qualified, or lightweight effort levels; never send messages.

skills.name: positioning-and-messaging
skills.description: Activate when developing, reviewing, or refining product positioning, value propositions, battlecards, buyer messaging, or approved message-house claims.

skills.name: predictive-problems
skills.description: Activate when identifying or reviewing likely future business problems from current evidence and patterns.

skills.name: reply-handling-and-objections
skills.description: Activate when retrieving and classifying an authorized email reply, drafting an objection-aware response, or stopping follow-up after a reply, rejection, unsubscribe, meeting, or out-of-office event.

skills.name: revenue-attribution
skills.description: Activate when linking evidence and approved GTM actions to pipeline or revenue outcomes with explicit attribution limits.

skills.name: seo-fundamentals
skills.description: Activate when auditing an explicitly authorized website for technical SEO, crawlability, indexing, metadata, headings, internal links, content relevance, page experience, mobile readiness, or structured data; this optional module never deploys or merges changes.
